gen-fs-new-title-gf-enriqueta: Linked-together letters with lowercase that towers over its capitals give New Title a bold, modern swagger, and Enriqueta sits beneath it, quieter and shorter. Its chalky curves stop before they close, which gives a long read a literary, dignified pace.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-fenix: Fenix reads like an old editorial page, its curved strokes stopping short before they turn inward. New Title above it stands lofty and chained together, so display and serif trade places easily.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-gentium-plus: Chunky, modern, tightly linked. New Title is all lofty lowercase and chain-like joins, built to announce things; Gentium Plus does the quieter work, its c opening wide like a pitcher's mouth for refined reading.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-gowun-batang: Refined is the mood Gowun Batang brings, its terminals cut back to leave a generous gap in every letter. And New Title, bold and modern with lofty lowercase locked together like chain links, gives that serif a punchy headline to stand under.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-habibi: Traditional and editorial, Habibi lays a clear channel into its rounded letters. New Title above it is the opposite, bold and modern with lofty lowercase locked link to link, so the body can be sized modestly without losing its footing.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-inika: New Title links its letters like a fine chain. Its lowercase rises high above the capitals for a bold, modern look, while Inika quietly offers a see-through gap in each s and a traditional, classic body.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-kay-pho-du: New Title is the bold, modern voice here, with lofty lowercase and letters locked like links in a chain. But Kay Pho Du carries the reading, its counters breathing open and its single-width, rolling-ball-pen line giving a traditional serif feel over many paragraphs.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-labrada: Labrada is dignified and bookish, with wide openings in its small letters. New Title overhead goes bolder and more modern, its high lowercase linked like a fine chain, so the heading shouts a little while the serif body settles in.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-montaga: Montaga reads bookish and editorial, its pen-lifted curves leaving each loop pleasantly unfinished. Montaga's strokes run like thread stitched along a path, so a stretch of text feels hand-sewn, while New Title above holds the bold, chain-linked lead.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-new-tegomin: Dignified yet punchy. New Title links its high lowercase like a fine chain for a bold, modern top line, and New Tegomin follows with a wide-open ring of a c, giving a traditional serif a measured, steady read.
